_comment: Above the base rate, and an offer DOES make money -- $19.59 -- but the minimum an action must be worth is $20.00, so it misses by 41 cents. This is the sub-case the minimum expected value created: not 'every offer loses money', but 'the best one is not worth an agent's time'. Added in v5.1 so that branch is exercised by a real record.
